body:
### This mod is still in early test, so if you discover bugs, please report it.
### 
_# Kingdom Come-Style Combat for Minecraft

> A complete overhaul of Minecraft combat — inspired by **Kingdom Come: Deliverance II**, built around **directional attacks**, **stamina management**, realistic armor interaction, advanced AI, and deep data pack customization.

---

## Directional Combat System

Say goodbye to simple clicks.

This mod replaces Minecraft’s basic combat with a **direction-based melee system**, where every attack matters.

* Attack from different directions
* Manage your stamina carefully
* Read your opponent’s movement
* Punish missed attacks
* Chain attacks into powerful combos

---

## Human Mob AI

Human model mobs receive a completely new AI system designed for tactical combat.

---

## New Damage Types

Weapons now deal different types of damage depending on how they are used.

### Damage Types

| Type       | Description                                   |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| **Slash**  | Used by swords, axes, and cutting weapons     |
| **Strike** | Used by hammers, maces, and blunt weapons     |
| **Thrust** | Used by pickaxe, sword, and stabbing attacks |

Each weapon finally feels different.

---

## Armor That Actually Matters

Armor is no longer just a number.

Plate armor can stop a sword from cutting through it, while blunt weapons may be more effective against heavily armored enemies.

while wearing heavy armor slow you down

But armor does not make you invincible.

A well-placed strike to an exposed area — such as the head, neck, hands, or joints — can completely change the fight.

> Heavy armor protects you, but weak points still matter.

---

## Accurate Hit Detection

This mod introduces a more precise collision and hit system.

Instead of simply damaging the whole mob, attacks can connect with specific body parts.

Examples:

* If an enemy wears a chestplate, aim for the head
* If armor covers one area, look for another opening

---

## Combos and Advanced Animations

Master a wide range of combat techniques and combos.

*Learn* attack patterns, combine directions, and unlock devastating moves through practice.

*Features* include:

* Directional combo chains
* Unique weapon animations
* Heavy, light, and follow-up attacks
* Smooth combat movement
* Cinematic melee exchanges

The goal is to make every duel feel intense, physical, and satisfying.


---

## Visual Combat Effects

Combat should look as powerful as it feels.

This mod adds immersive visual feedback, including:

* Blood effects
* Damaged armor visuals
* Visible impact marks
* Wounds that remain on creatures
* Broken armor details during combat

Every fight leaves a mark.


## New Enchantment System

Enchantments are redesigned to make weapons feel more specialized and meaningful.

Bows and crossbows can now be pushed in different directions:


The choice is no longer simply “which weapon has better numbers.”


> Do you want speed, range, or raw stopping power?

Melee weapons also gain more focused enchantment paths.

You can build weapons around specific damage types:

* **Slash-focused enchantments** for cutting weapons
* **Strike-focused enchantments** for blunt force weapons
* **Thrust-focused enchantments** for piercing attacks
* Armor-breaking effects
* Stamina-pressure effects
* Weak-point damage bonuses


---

## Passive Skill System

Learn passive skills to shape the way you fight.

Passive skills can improve your combat ability in different ways, allowing players to build unique fighting styles.

Possible passive skill paths include:

* Better stamina recovery
* Reduced stamina cost for certain attacks
* Stronger blocks and counters
... and more

Passive skills make progression feel deeper and more personal.


---

## Powerful Data Pack Support

Almost everything in this mod is designed to be customizable through data packs.

You can modify:

* Weapon damage types
* Armor protection values
* Mob combat behavior
* Hit zones
* Combos
* Stamina costs
* Damage modifiers
* Compatibility settings for other mods
  ... and more

This makes it easier to integrate weapons, armor, and mobs from other mods into the new combat system.

> Build your own combat experience — without rewriting the mod.
